designs.name: Pandin bambus party
designs.prompt: One original flat invitation BACKGROUND, portrait exact5:7, preferred1500x2100px. Full-bleed artwork itself, viewed straight on. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. No collage, mockup, paper sheet, parchment, scroll, card edges, table, hands, perspective presentation or external shadow. The underlying color flows continuously through the whole image; do not introduce a blank paper panel or frame. Keep every important ornament fully inside a5mm safe inset, about5% of the width. Leave naturally calm areas for large editable text to be added later, integrated with the composition. Joyful first birthday for a baby boy. A charming small panda hugging a rich turquoise bamboo shoot, placed in the lower right, with a few teal bamboo leaves nearby and tiny vivid coral confetti accents. Sunny saturated golden YELLOW ground across the whole image, with plenty of smooth yellow open area above and on the lower left. Playful premium flat gouache children's-book art, clean shapes and expressive friendly character. No balloons, no paper textures, no large off-white empty middle. Keep the panda and every bamboo leaf completely away from the image edges.
